turns.response_html: A capacitor consists of two conductive plates separated by a non-conductive material called a dielectric. These components are often rolled into a cylinder. The schematic symbol for a capacitor typically shows two parallel lines, representing the two plates. For polarized capacitors, one line may be curved or have a plus sign to indicate polarity.
